description: A triangle or ramp low-frequency oscillator whose rate can be set by hand or worked out from an incoming clock

params.text: Switches between the RATE knob and the rate worked out from the SYNC input; with nothing patched to SYNC it holds the oscillator at its last value instead, and pressing again releases it
Sets how many pulses at the SYNC input make one cycle of the main rate, 1 to 24
Multiplies or divides this oscillator's rate against the main rate, from a twenty-first of it to twenty-one times it, with the centre position matching
Chooses the waveshape: ramp up, triangle or ramp down
Sets where in its cycle the oscillator restarts after a reset, 0° to 360°

inputs.text: Moves the main rate, ten hertz per volt at full attenuverter, added to the RATE knob
The pulses the main rate is worked out from, counted off against the PPC knob
A trigger here does what the SYNC button does
Attenuates the output, added to the SCL knob
A trigger here restarts the cycle from the position the Ph knob sets

menu: Wait full clock after reset — with sync on, a reset holds the cycle until a whole clock has passed before restarting it, which keeps a PPC above 1 lined up
